commands.name: overview
commands.summary: Show what the archive holds per source, how fresh it is, and where to start.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Check that Teams, Outlook, Full Disk Access and the archive are ready.

commands.name: sync
commands.summary: Read Teams chats, Outlook mail and the calendar into the archive once; print what changed.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Show archive counts per account, the last sync and other Teams origins.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Full-text search over Teams chats, mail, transcripts, notes, documents and archived content.

commands.name: messages
commands.summary: List Teams messages in chronological order from the archive.

commands.name: conversations
commands.summary: List Teams conversations, newest activity first.

commands.name: teams
commands.summary: List teams with channel counts, last activity and unread counts.

commands.name: people list
commands.summary: List Teams and mail people with native Outlook observations.

commands.name: people sync
commands.summary: Register and capture native Outlook people observations from supported profiles.

commands.name: people show
commands.summary: Inspect one native person observation with its copies and contradictions.

commands.name: people sources
commands.summary: Show registered native people sources and their coverage.

commands.name: activity
commands.summary: List activity-feed items (mentions, replies, reactions) with their messages.

commands.name: coverage
commands.summary: Show, per day and source, whether the archive holds what the apps cached.

commands.name: calendar agenda
commands.summary: List calendar events for a date range, offline.

commands.name: calendar event
commands.summary: Show one calendar event with everything the archive holds about it.

commands.name: calendar sources
commands.summary: Show, per account and source, the days the calendar archive holds.

commands.name: calendar actions
commands.summary: List action items of meeting recaps for events in a range.

commands.name: calendar attendees sync
commands.summary: Capture native selected-detail attendee evidence from supported Outlook sources.

commands.name: calendar attendees sources
commands.summary: Read registered native attendee sources and their archive coverage.

commands.name: calendar attendees list
commands.summary: List an event's native attendee observations from the selected source.

commands.name: calendar attendees show
commands.summary: Show one attendee observation with its snapshot and coverage.

commands.name: mail list
commands.summary: List archived Outlook mail, newest first.

commands.name: mail show
commands.summary: Show one message's headers, body and attachment names, sizes and types.

commands.name: mail thread
commands.summary: Show a mail conversation: its reply chain and shared subject.

commands.name: mail folders
commands.summary: List mail folders with message and unread counts.

commands.name: mail unread
commands.summary: List unread mail by folder.

commands.name: workiq enable
commands.summary: Enable the optional WorkIQ source for this archive.

commands.name: workiq disable
commands.summary: Disable WorkIQ acquisition without removing retained data.

commands.name: workiq sync
commands.summary: Acquire mail or selected chat history through WorkIQ fetch.

commands.name: workiq coverage
commands.summary: Count WorkIQ folders and chat messages without keeping payloads.

commands.name: workiq status
commands.summary: Probe WorkIQ identity and initial path access; never signs in.

commands.name: writes on
commands.summary: Turn writes on for this archive; the person types it on the controlling terminal.

commands.name: writes off
commands.summary: Turn writes off for this archive; the person types it on the controlling terminal.

commands.name: writes status
commands.summary: Show the writes switch and the newest directed writes, offline.

commands.name: writes target
commands.summary: Read a chat's recipients and version through WorkIQ; writes nothing.

commands.name: writes send-teams-message
commands.summary: Send a plain-text Teams chat message the person directed, through WorkIQ.

commands.name: writes save-mail-draft
commands.summary: Save a new plain-text mail draft in the person's own mailbox.

commands.name: writes reply-mail
commands.summary: Reply in plain text to one mail as the person directed.

commands.name: writes reply-all-mail
commands.summary: Reply to everyone on one mail in plain text as the person directed.

commands.name: writes send-mail
commands.summary: Send a new plain-text mail the person directed.

commands.name: writes discard-mail-draft
commands.summary: Discard one draft in the person's own mailbox as the person directed.

commands.name: writes add-reaction
commands.summary: Add the person's emoji reaction to one chat message as the person directed.

commands.name: writes remove-reaction
commands.summary: Remove the person's emoji reaction from one chat message as the person directed.

commands.name: writes verify
commands.summary: Re-read the server to settle a write whose outcome is unknown; sends nothing.

commands.name: writes settle
commands.summary: Settle an unknown write after the person checks it on the controlling terminal.

commands.name: notes sync
commands.summary: Capture OneNote indexed notes locally from default Mac indexes or a directory.

commands.name: notes list
commands.summary: List indexed notes with stable IDs and source coverage.

commands.name: notes search
commands.summary: Search archived note titles, text and OCR.

commands.name: notes show
commands.summary: Show one note's text, elements and indexed hierarchy.

commands.name: notes sources
commands.summary: Show registered note sources, capture history and coverage.

commands.name: docs sync
commands.summary: Register and capture Office document metadata and OneDrive usage records; never opens files.

commands.name: docs list
commands.summary: List document observations with stable IDs and source coverage.

commands.name: docs search
commands.summary: Search retained document metadata, URLs and sharing claims.

commands.name: docs show
commands.summary: Inspect one document observation and its raw claims.

commands.name: docs sources
commands.summary: Inspect registered document source health without capture.

commands.name: loop sync
commands.summary: Register archived cached Loop snapshot records and project their channels.

commands.name: loop list
commands.summary: List retained Loop channel observations with stable IDs.

commands.name: loop search
commands.summary: Search retained Loop channel text and paths.

commands.name: loop show
commands.summary: Inspect one Loop channel from one cached snapshot.

commands.name: loop sources
commands.summary: Inspect registered Loop sources, their raw-match state and failures.

commands.name: scout sync
commands.summary: Copy Scout session files already in the local OneDrive folder into the archive.

commands.name: scout list
commands.summary: List archived Scout sessions, most recent activity first.

commands.name: scout search
commands.summary: Search the messages of archived Scout sessions.

commands.name: scout show
commands.summary: Show one Scout session with its messages.

commands.name: scout sources
commands.summary: Show each Scout folder read, its last scan and file counts.

commands.name: drafts list
commands.summary: List own cached compose-body projections already archived; never refreshes.

commands.name: drafts show
commands.summary: Inspect one cached compose-body frame.

commands.name: content images
commands.summary: List bounded image references in one cached Teams message, offline.

commands.name: content capture
commands.summary: Capture one guarded, already-resident Office file or native file reference.

commands.name: content fetch image
commands.summary: Export one verified selected Teams PNG through read-only WorkIQ.

commands.name: content fetch engage-thread
commands.summary: Capture one Engage thread link with its starter and replies.

commands.name: content fetch engage-home
commands.summary: Capture bounded native Engage Home-session thread-starter observations.

commands.name: content fetch page
commands.summary: Acquire a supported rich-text page projection (always partial).

commands.name: content fetch stream
commands.summary: Acquire one verified selected transcript or its metadata.

commands.name: content fetch doc
commands.summary: Read one OneDrive or SharePoint Office file through WorkIQ, when its rights allow.

commands.name: content signin
commands.summary: Open a visible window for the tool-owned profile so the person can sign in.

commands.name: content list
commands.summary: List immutable retained content observations, newest first.

commands.name: content search
commands.summary: Search retained content text, titles and native metadata offline.

commands.name: content show
commands.summary: Read one retained content observation offline.

commands.name: content sources
commands.summary: Read registered content source coverage offline.

commands.name: transcripts list
commands.summary: List meetings with recordings and their transcript parts, offline.

commands.name: transcripts show
commands.summary: Print a meeting's transcript from the archive in time order.

commands.name: transcripts fetch
commands.summary: Fetch a meeting's transcript parts from SharePoint and store them.

commands.name: transcripts signin
commands.summary: Open m365crawl's browser profile in a visible window so the person can sign in to SharePoint.

commands.name: stores
commands.summary: List archived databases and object stores without a typed table, with record counts.

commands.name: records
commands.summary: List archived records of one database, newest change first.

commands.name: unread
commands.summary: List unread Teams messages, newest first.

commands.name: thread
commands.summary: Show one Teams thread from a conversation and root message, or a message link.

commands.name: watch
commands.summary: Stream one JSON line per new, edited or deleted Teams message or activity item.

commands.name: whoami
commands.summary: Show the accounts in the archive and the archive's state.

commands.name: sql
commands.summary: Run a read-only SQL query against the archive.

commands.name: skill
commands.summary: Print the agent guide (SKILL.md) for this version.

commands.name: metadata
commands.summary: Print the crawlkit app manifest.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Print the m365crawl version, commit and build date.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Print every command as JSON, with who sees its effect, and the exit codes.
